mapper.sql: r.id, r.record_no, r.parking_lot_id, r.parking_space_id, r.fee_rule_id, r.vehicle_id, r.license_plate, r.entry_time, r.status, a.area_code, s.space_code
FROM parking_record r JOIN parking_space s ON s.id = r.parking_space_id JOIN parking_area a ON a.id = s.area_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (payment_no, parking_record_id, amount_due, amount_paid, payment_method, payment_time, remark, handled_by) VALUES (#{paymentNo}, #{parkingRecordId}, #{amountDue}, #{amountPaid}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentTime}, #{remark}, #{handledBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE parking_record SET status = 'COMPLETED', exit_time = #{exitTime}, exit_admin_id = #{exitAdminId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PARKING'
UPDATE parking_space SET status = 'FREE', updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{spaceId} AND status = 'OCCUPIED'
UPDATE parking_record SET status = 'ABNORMAL', abnormal_reason = #{reason}, exit_time = #{exitTime}, exit_admin_id = #{exitAdminId}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PARKING'
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_record WHERE payment_no = #{paymentNo})
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM payment_record WHERE parking_record_id = #{recordId}
